g.text: Demo uses SQLite and local tracker defaults. The CLI leases its command and invokes the Supervisor directly.
Full host requires coordinated SQL, identity, broker, Redis and durable paths. Tracker can instead use the dev local adapter.
Linux /proc boot identity and POSIX process groups constrain recovery. Native macOS full-lifecycle execution is unqualified.
